title: The nature of the spectrum of generalized Paley graphs and weak Waring numbers over finite fields
summary: We consider the family of generalized Paley graphs (GP-graphs for short) $Γ(k,q) = Cay(\mathbb{F}_q, (\mathbb{F}_q^*)^k)$, with $q=p^m$ and $p$ prime. We characterize all GP-graphs having real spectrum; namely, $Spec(Γ(k,q)) \subset \mathbb{R}$ if and only if $Γ(k,q)$ is undirected. We then study conditions for integrality in the spectrum and give a general method to produce integral GP-graphs through cyclotomic polynomials.
